title: The Museum of Good Reasons
description: Its invitation is to understand more without making someone's loss conveniently disappear.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: The Museum of Good Reasons explores a fictional institution built around justification. Its exhibits explain how things disappear without anyone admitting theft. Mara arrives to catalogue objects inside this unsettling museum.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Its invitation is to understand more without making someone's loss conveniently disappear.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: The Museum of Good Reasons suits readers drawn to unsettling philosophical fiction.
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: The Museum of Good Reasons suits readers drawn to unsettling philosophical fiction.
readerOutcomes: The details make the institution persuasive as well as disturbing.
A catalogue can preserve a history or make a person disappear from it.
The question is not only what happened, but who may describe its meaning.
Their concrete encounters keep complexity from becoming another reason to stop looking.
What matters now is the pressure between comprehending harm and excusing it.
For the alternative entrance, let the book's own note establish the terms.
